records.explanation: No table or column in the warehouse holds credit scores or credit ratings. It only has invoices, payments, deals, orders, partners and receivables aging, so Northwind Logistics' credit score can't be answered.
No table has a salesperson or deal owner field (staging.stg_deals has only deal, partner, stage, won/lost and dates), so deals can't be attributed to a salesperson.
Gross margin needs cost of goods sold or product cost data, and the warehouse only holds revenue-side data (deals, orders, invoices, payments), so it can't be calculated.
The warehouse has no support ticket data (only deals, orders, invoices, payments, partners), so tickets opened by Acme Corporation can't be counted.

The warehouse holds only historical invoices, orders, payments and deals. It has no billing schedule, recurring-invoice plan or planned invoice dates, so next month's billing can't be derived without guessing.
